hero.method: Isolated Chromium browser preview: 14 seconds of native video across two car chapters. Phone and touch tablet at DPR 2 and 4x CPU throttle; laptop at normal CPU. RAF timings and native video frame counters are bounded emulation, not physical iPhone/Samsung FPS.

carousel.method: Headless Chromium during native CDP phone touch and desktop wheel momentum, not just next-button clicks. Phone: 390px, DPR 2, CPU 4x. Desktop: 1440px, CPU 1x. Warm responsive images. These are bounded emulated measurements, not physical-device FPS.

cold.method: Cold browser cache, phone 390x844 at DPR 3, 6x CPU slowdown, 1.6 Mbps down/600 kbps up and 150 ms latency through local web-server gzip/range delivery. Sustained native hero playback for two complete six-car cycles. This does not emulate real cellular packet loss or certify a physical phone.

methodLimits: Browser emulation is not physical-device certification.
